name: a-cold-row-in-another-profile-opens-in-its-row-in-a-second-window
description: A second window moves to a space of another profile, and a cold row there opens in its row. Only the first window had a strip for each profile, so the second window opened the row in its own profile and added a new row. Alpha belongs to the Default profile and Bravo to the Second profile.

actions.note: gate: the app is up on Alpha's own tab
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
marks the first window's sidebar, so a later eval that reaches it reports that and does not pass

actions.pattern: Atrium: Cmd\+N opened window-slot .* for host

actions.note: the new window opens its palette, and an Escape before the palette has key does nothing
a press on the palette's scrim, because Escape alone is unreliable here
the second window moves into Bravo's space, which belongs to the Second profile

actions.expression: (() => { if (window.__atriumFirstWindow) { return 'first-window'; } const rs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane[data-space-index="1"] [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')]; return rs.length + ' rows, cold ' + rs.filter((x) => (x.dataset.url || '').endsWith('?cold')).map((x) => x.dataset.tabId ? 'live' : 'cold').join('+'); })()

(() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane[data-space-index="1"] [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')].find((x) => (x.dataset.url || '').endsWith('?cold')); if (!r) { return 'no-cold-row'; } const b = r.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round(window.screenX + b.left + 60) + ',' + Math.round(window.screenY + (b.top + b.bottom) / 2); })()
actions.note: the cold row's centre on screen, from the second window's own origin

'live' : 'cold').join('+'); })()

assertions.desc: gate: the second window shows Bravo's two rows and the second one is cold

assertions.desc: the second window shows the Second profile's strip
